2608.10970.title: ReLTEx: Reliable LLM-based Taxonomy Expansion
2608.10970.paper_summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in generating semantically relevant concepts and relations, making them promising tools for taxonomy enrichment. However, directly relying on LLM-generated expansions often leads to noisy, redundant, or hierarchically inconsistent structures, limiting their reliability for automated taxonomy expansion. In this paper, we present ReLTEx, a framework for reliable LLM-based taxonomy expansion. ReLTEx combines LLM-driven candidate generation with structure-aware validation and recursive expansion control to improve the consistency and quality of generated taxonomies by reducing hallucinations. We evaluate the proposed framework using benchmark taxonomies under a masked taxonomy expansion setting and compare multiple validation strategies. Experimental results, supported by both adapted evaluation metrics and human evaluation, demonstrate that ReLTEx produces more reliable and semantically coherent taxonomy expansions.
2608.10970.paper_summary_zh: 最近在大型語言模型（LLMs）方面的進展展示了在生成語義相關的概念和關係方面的強大能力，使其成為有前景的分類法豐富工具。<lb/>然而，直接依賴LLM生成的擴展通常會導致嘈雜、冗餘或層次不一致的結構，限制了其在自動分類法擴展中的可靠性。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了ReLTEx，一個基於LLM的可靠分類法擴展框架。<lb/>ReLTEx結合了LLM驅動的候選生成、結構感知的驗證和遞歸擴展控制，以通過減少幻覺來提高生成分類法的一致性和質量。<lb/>我們在遮蔽的分類法擴展設置下使用基準分類法評估所提出的框架，並比較多種驗證策略。<lb/>實驗結果，通過適應的評估指標和人類評估支持，證明ReLTEx能夠生成更可靠且語義一致的分類法擴展。
